scope: Read-only pre-dispatch review of frozen plan, complete controller source, local pinned inputs, native workflow/protocol, and retained initial public-provider observation. The reviewer performed no network call, credential-helper call, dispatch, poll, scientific replay, Git mutation or author approval.

scientific_target_review.common_target_binding: Pinned repository/source commit/native protocol plus exact author ZIP, Wine data and 25-draw numerical cell. All common author/data/target fields equal the actual pinned native protocol.
scientific_target_review.event_unit: (repository, run_id, attempt), distinguished from archive identity, repeated reference and source commit.
scientific_target_review.two_references_one_event: Duplicating the retained v09 reference gives one admitted event, so the open-scope r=2 request remains UNRESOLVED.
scientific_target_review.two_actual_events: If the one newly dispatched event satisfies every pre-frozen admission condition, old+new provide two distinct run identities for the run-only dimension and can support the fixed r=2 request.
scientific_target_review.shared_input_and_implementation: The two events use identical pinned dataset and author implementation. Adding these dimensions prevents a disjoint pair; the declared result remains UNRESOLVED. This is not an independent-dataset/team/design claim.
scientific_target_review.semantic_boundary: The new common artifact-version target is explicit and shared before dispatch; individual run identity remains source metadata. Predicate replication, r=2, EXISTS_GROUP_FOR_ALL_WORLDS, and closed_scope=False are fixed. This is a bounded semantics/identity calibration, not a change to the proof core or a statistical replication claim.
scientific_target_review.same_information_baseline: The plan requires independent parsing/arithmetic/provenance and SQL event/dimension joins from the same old/new originals, with no candidate fact table or certificate supplied to the baseline. That later implementation still needs review.
scientific_target_review.failure_rule: Failure or missing new evidence remains retained but unadmitted; no outcome target adjustment or repeat-until-pass. Open scope yields UNRESOLVED rather than global negative evidence.
scientific_target_review.environment_limit: Same source/data/protocol does not fix apt versions or guarantee identical CSV bytes. This limitation is explicit.

input_binding_review.native_workflow: manual workflow_dispatch only; same fixed workflow file; run_author timeout25min and attest job5min; pinned actions; checkout persist-credentials=false. Attestation permissions are confined to the existing success-dependent second job.

controller_review.plan_pin_chain: validate_plan compares the exact controller descriptor and all14 source plus7 old-evidence descriptors. dispatch additionally requires a PASS review with this exact plan SHA; controller SHA is transitively frozen inside that reviewed plan.
controller_review.pre_post_remote_binding: preflight requires a clean local HEAD at the frozen commit and exact git ls-remote origin refs/heads/trace-isolation-v09-fd-observation equality. The local origin was independently checked to be the intended public repository. Fixed-repository GitHub metadata must show the exact active workflow and complete terminal prior-run list; dispatch rejects any newly observed run or changed workflow ID before posting.
controller_review.single_post: dispatch first rejects any existing DISPATCH_INTENT_V01.json. It creates the intent with exclusive open, flush and fsync before obtaining credentials or issuing the sole gh api POST. No loop, retry, alternate branch or rerun endpoint exists.
controller_review.post_endpoint: repos/SHiJiE1115/newproj/actions/workflows/370241915/dispatches; POST field ref=trace-isolation-v09-fd-observation. No user-supplied route, hostname or additional flags.
controller_review.uncertain_outcome: Nonzero and exceptions preserve a result with no_retry=true. The durable intent blocks another dispatch invocation even after an ambiguous result. Recovery is read-only poll/inspection; never a second POST.
controller_review.poll_identity: Poll selects only IDs absent from the frozen prior list with the exact commit, branch, workflow_dispatch event, attempt1 and creation time no earlier than the intent. It independently reads run/jobs/artifacts for the selected ID. Zero matches wait; multiple matches are ambiguous and do not assign identity. Once NEW_RUN_IDENTITY_V01.json exists, any different identity is rejected.
controller_review.terminal_is_not_acceptance: The poll status TERMINAL means completed; failure conclusions remain visible. It neither admits a receipt nor establishes the plan support conditions. Exact provider/tar/artifact/native/direct/fresh-signature binding must be validated in the later acceptance phase.
controller_review.credential_handling: Uses the ordinary Git credential helper for protocol=https and host=github.com, with noninteractive options. The returned password stays in memory and is passed as GH_TOKEN only through the gh child environment, with fixed GH_HOST. Helper output is never printed/stored; child output containing the exact secret is withheld. Dispatch receipts retain only exit/lengths/exception class, never token, environment or credential stdout/stderr.
controller_review.write_scope: New iteration311 state and uniquely named maintenance guard receipts only. Git calls are read-only; there is no commit, push, main edit, workflow edit or submission API.

required_later_acceptance: Keep this plan, source, numerical target and once-only limit fixed regardless of outcome.
Bind the selected new provider identity to the exact artifact bytes and the same tar supplied to both native and independent direct verifiers.
Require both jobs success and fresh cryptographic verification of tar subject, signer/source/ref and new invocation URI before admitting the new event.
Evaluate fixed three-row matrix from independently admitted old/new evidence; a returned HTTP/gh success or completed job alone is insufficient.
limits: Pre-dispatch PASS is permission-gate technical review of this exact code/plan, not a prediction of runtime success.
No new run has been dispatched or observed by this reviewer.
Initial metadata is a retained provider observation, not an independently refreshed network observation.
No human review, author factual approval, historical authenticity, independent dataset/team/design, method superiority or novelty certification.
